name: vichar-ai
description: Vichar AI — an emotionally intelligent AI wellness companion. Because every feeling deserves to be heard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
